subject: Re: KNF kickoff - forecasting that survives distribution shift
body:
Ximena,

Staffing: Fumiko Rossi 50% as method owner (operators + feedback loop), Giannis Sato 40% on the data generation scripts (M4 via m4_data_gen.py, Cryptos via cryptos_data_gen.py) and training harness, Bilal Novak 40% on the shift-injection eval framework.

Compute for the window itself is modest - 24 A100s on titan-a100, best effort covers it.

On funding for the Q3 scale-up: I met with Idris on Tuesday. Idris has verbally earmarked $120k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-60 for KNF, which covers the full scale-up sweep, so I'm treating the Q3 compute question as closed. I'll get it papered when the Q3 budget cycle opens, but I'm confident enough to plan hiring-adjacent decisions around it.

One flag: Bilal is fielding requests from another team, I've told him KNF eval framework comes first through April.

Bao
